component.name: Limbo
component.summary: Downloads, torrents and Debrid in one place, with a built-in browser and a library

description.p: Limbo brings everything you download into one app. Paste a link or a magnet, or open a .torrent file, and it queues, resumes and finishes the transfer for you.

ul.li: Direct downloads with a queue, resume and a limit on how many run at once
Torrents from magnet links and .torrent files, with optional seeding
Automatic extraction of zip, 7z and rar archives, including multi-part sets
A built-in browser with bookmarks and popup blocking
A library that collects finished downloads alongside folders you add

description.p: You're responsible for having the right to download what you use Limbo for.
